one_liner: Jamal Murray shoots 41.6 percent from three -- the highest three-point rate among the guards profiled in this expanded marquee set.
three_things: 41.6 percent from deep with 23.8 points per 36 minutes.
The playmaking load is substantial at 6.8 assists per 36.
87.6 percent from the line completes a shooting-first profile.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. The comparison is scoped to the players with insight files in this set, not to the full 482-player atlas.
